library.name: CodeMirror 6
library.description: Code editor and syntax highlighter. Bundled at build time (Rollup) from the npm packages codemirror (6.0.2), @codemirror/state (6.6.0), @codemirror/view (6.43.0), @codemirror/commands (6.x), @codemirror/lint (6.x), @codemirror/lang-python, @codemirror/lang-sql, @codemirror/lang-javascript, @lezer/highlight (1.2.3) and @lezer/common (1.5.2).
